profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with ‘Can do and Will do’ attitude having extensive experience developing large scale distributed systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer working on Wearables and Meta AI

positions.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
positions.description: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Solution Architecture · People Management · Coaching & Mentoring · Recruiting · Negotiation · Leadership · Strategic Partnerships · Web Development · Java · Go (Programming Language) · Python (Programming Language) · Node.js · angular · TypeScript · JavaScript

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as Senior/Lead Software Engineer designing and implementing different solutions to support ERP and migrating legacy component to newer bleeding edge technologies for future growth.

Worked on performing the technical feasibility study for the migration of legacy system including the risk and benefits of moving to newer technology.

Worked on designing and implementing solutions to migrate legacy Silverlight/WCF based web components to HTML5/Angular/ASP.NET Web API based multi-platform including tablet supported solution.

Worked on designing and implementing UI Automation Testing framework to support regression testing after every build using  Jenkins, Selenium and Java.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a Senior Software Engineer on custom application for Government agency. Primary responsibilities included providing technical documentation to support proposal, technical documentation to support newer software/modules, designing pilot applications for different ideas to improve solutions, writing custom software using different technologies including but not limited to .NET, Java, NodeJs, Oracle, SQL , AngularJS and AWS. 

Designed and Implemented cloud friendly micro services to support fast searching using ASP.NET Web API, SQL Server, AngularJS and ElasticSearch.

Designed and Implemented cloud friendly hybrid (web + background services) solution to ingest large chunks of data from external system.

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description: Worked as Team Lead developing scientific solution using .NET 4.0/4.5 & WPF framework. The entire system was built using Managed Extensibility Framework (MEF)  and custom ExxonMobil frameworks.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked as Software Developer providing IT services using technologies like .NET 4.0/4.5, WCF Rest Based Web Services, Entity Framework, jQuery & Knockout.js to different clients accrediting different institutes.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained dynamic WIN/WPF forms to incorporate different functionality. 

Developed and maintained different web componenets using C#, jQuery, MVC 3.0 and WCF.

Configured and maintained Google Search Appliance for supporting enterprise search.

Created UI components for enterprise search using XSLT.

Created SAML-Bridge, Feeder application to support enterprise search application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design web based applications using MVP + SOA design pattern.

Develop dynamic user interfaces and user controls using C#.NET, ASP.NET 3.5/4.0, LINQ, Ajax, JQuery and Telerik UI ASP.NET Ajax control library.

Create test cases using NUnit framework.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on with C#.NET + (XML, Javascript and Ajax) for Front end and MS SQL Server for Back end.

Mainly worked on designing and implementing user interfaces for users for capturing application, validating application based on eligibility criteria and reviewing the submitted application based on review criteria. This also included maintaining applicant's portfolio.

Other responsibilities included requirements documentation and analysis, software operations and maintenance, collaboration with Quality Assurance Engineers to ensure proper test plans and execution of integration and functionality tests.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Mainly worked on with the Microsoft technology team developing web based systems for client using ASP.NET (C#) and SQL.
